0.context: Daniel 12 contains the Hebrew Bible's clearest resurrection statement. Multitudes who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, others to shame and everlasting contempt. Unlike the ambiguous metaphorical references in Job and Hosea, this passage explicitly describes bodily resurrection with judgment and different outcomes for the righteous and wicked, a theological development consistent with the second temple period thought, when resurrection became central to Jewish theology.
